title: sieccwinter: Reproducible Winter Weather and Social-Outcome Analysis for the SIECC Study
description: R package implementing the SIECC Winter analytical workflow: cumulative-window regressions, L01-L56 distributed-lag models, Benjamini-Hochberg families, input validation and comparison with frozen aggregate reference outputs. It contains no study data; a fully synthetic data set is provided for workflow demonstration only.
